shared_elements: upper zone with figural/emblematic imagery over a lower zone of repeated marks
carved surface with incised linear signs
vertical slab-like or upright monolithic format
paired/symmetrical motifs flanking a central axis
justification: Both are upright monolithic carved surfaces divided into an upper zone of emblematic motifs (including a prominent disc/circle) above a lower zone of repeated incised marks, and both use flanking symmetrical elements about a central axis. But A is a flat, arched slab densely covered in fine, regular rows of small linear signs rendered as a crisp line drawing, whereas B is a three-dimensional, heavily weathered rounded figure with a few large, shallow relief motifs and no dense text-like registers.
